messages:
Asha (CS): quick async standup for Velaris account — collecting short updates (what I did / blockers / today). :wave: Who's on this?

Derek (Eng): yesterday: deployed webhook retry hotfix to canary, verified in staging. blocker: can't reproduce the 502 under concurrent load, only seen in prod. today: add more request/response logs + increase backoff.

Priya (Solutions): FYI Velaris reports latency spikes when batch_size >= 8. I captured prompt samples and steps; shared in the Velaris ticket. need a short QA window to try smaller batches.

Jonah (Support): got 3 escalations overnight, same stacktrace. customer asking for ETA, pushing for either a rollback or mitigation by 11:30 PT.

Asha (CS): opened an escalation with the AM and CSM. Velaris wants a short report to share with their infra team. @Derek can you paste a sample failing request/response (redact tokens) so I can forward?

Derek (Eng): paste below (redacted):
```
POST /webhook/velaris HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json
{ "request_id": "xyz-123", "payload": "<redacted>" }
--- response ---
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"upstream read error","code":502}
```
Not perfect but same pattern. Also added a temporary route to drop very large payloads with `x-velaris-truncate: true`.

Priya (Solutions): scheduled a 30m QA window at 10:30 PT to try `max_batch_size=4` and a shorter tokenization path. If that reproduces less frequently we can push as a hot config.

ops-bot: Incident INC-453 created for velaris-webhook, severity=P2. Assigned to Derek (Eng). https://internal.incidents/INC-453

Jonah (Support): noted. I'll update Velaris at 10:45 PT that we're testing mitigations. asking them not to ramp traffic during the window. :eyes: 

Asha (CS): today's goals: 1) narrow root cause (serialization/backpressure) 2) push temporary mitigation to prod if QA looks good 3) send a short status note to Velaris post-QA. blocker: need prod logs for 09:50-11:00 PT window (especially proxy timeout traces). @Derek please confirm pull.

Derek (Eng): pulling logs now (tailing prod cluster logs across nodes). if I don't have actionable find in 20m escalate to @Priya. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Priya (Solutions): copying the small config snippet I'll apply to canary for testing: `service.webhook.max_batch_size=4` `service.webhook.timeout_ms=12000` `enable_prefix_cache=true`.

Asha (CS): thanks team — will post a summary here after QA. :thumbsup: 

Jonah (Support): quick note — if Velaris asks for rollback path, we have a pre-approved rollback runbook under eng-releases. I'll link it in the ticket.

Derek (Eng): update: found a proxy-level 502 spike correlated with one box hitting fd exhaustion. restarting that node reduced errors in staging. replicating restart in prod in 5m if no objections.

Asha (CS): go for it — keep me posted. I'll hold off customer update until after results.

Jonah (Support): :+1:
